Say.notes: Plain text and the voice attribute map cleanly (voice passed through with a warning). KNOWN GAP: SSML markup inside Say is not yet preserved — inline SSML is escaped to literal text and child SSML elements are dropped. Both BW SpeakSentence and Twilio Say support SSML, so this is an adapter parser/serializer gap, not a platform limit.

loop.notes: Emitted once; BXML has no loop attribute.
Emitted once; BXML has no loop attribute.

Gather.notes: DTMF and speech both supported. Per dev.bandwidth.com, BW Gather input accepts dtmf/speech/dtmf_speech.

input.notes: Twilio dtmf / speech / 'dtmf speech' map to BW input dtmf / speech / dtmf_speech. Speech results arrive as the BW gather event's text field, surfaced to the customer app as Twilio's SpeechResult param.

Redirect.notes: URL moves from element text to redirectUrl attribute.

Reject.notes: Mapped to Hangup; Bandwidth answers before hanging up, so the caller may be billed for a short call.

Record.notes: Recording callback payloads differ; adapter normalizes.

playBeep.notes: No direct equivalent; adapter can prepend a beep PlayAudio later.

Dial.notes: Number/Sip nouns map to Transfer; Conference noun maps to Conference; Queue and Client nouns are unsupported. Deep Dial semantics (answerOnBridge, child-call status propagation) are not replicated in P0.

Enqueue.notes: Bandwidth has no queue primitive (P0 gap per PRD). Contact-center queue flows cannot migrate yet.

Pay.notes: PCI payment capture is out of scope (deferred per PRD).

Refer.notes: SIP REFER not translated in P0.

Connect.notes: Stream noun maps to StartStream via the Media Streams bridge; ConversationRelay and VirtualAgent are unsupported (separate IoV).

Stream.notes: Twilio WS message schema is emulated by the adapter's stream bridge; live Bandwidth-side binding requires fixture capture.

Conference.notes: Basic named conferences work. waitUrl hold music is NOT supported by Bandwidth; beep cues are partial.

waitUrl.notes: No conference hold-music equivalent (P1 gap per PRD).

Client.notes: Twilio Client (WebRTC) endpoints have no adapter mapping in P0.
